_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is statistically dominant (95% of windows are ±<2 points) and neither brain has produced a confirmed breaker — HOLD with defined triggers is the skilled call, not a forced guess.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative writer leans toward an imminent risk-on reversal while the analyst insists on HOLD until structural breakers confirm; I side with the analyst's higher trust weight and factor-level evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows > 30 and stablecoin_growth > 45 within 2-3 sessions (UP breaker) OR VIX > 75 with funding < 0 and btc_momentum_30d < 40 (DOWN breaker)
next_move.invalidated_if: Score drifts below 32 into Panic band (phase would shift -1 rung) or above 39 into Anxiety band (phase would shift +1 rung), breaking the Denial anchor
